jobs.title: Co-op Internships (Bermudian students)

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Legal Internship
jobs.dateNote: Applications open November 2026

jobs.summary: Walkers' annual programme gives students real exposure to legal practice in Bermuda. The firm also runs a pupillage programme.

jobs.title: DEEP Summer Internship

jobs.summary: Deloitte's Exclusive Experience Program: paid summer work plus a regional project with interns from across the Caribbean and Bermuda.

jobs.title: Bermuda Summer Law Student Programme 2027
jobs.dateNote: Applications open 1 January

jobs.summary: Eight weeks working alongside Conyers lawyers on live matters, from research and drafting to client meetings and court.

jobs.title: University Summer Work Placement & Gap Year Programme
jobs.dateNote: Dates not yet announced

jobs.summary: Non-legal placements across the firm's departments, plus a paid gap-year internship for students taking a year out.

jobs.title: Summer Internship Programme
jobs.dateNote: Expected to open January 2027

jobs.title: James W. Babcock Internship
jobs.dateNote: Applications open January 2027
jobs.eligibility: American undergraduate or graduate students
jobs.summary: Six weeks of marine conservation projects, research and animal husbandry in Bermuda.

jobs.title: Bermuda Program Summer Internship
jobs.company: ASU Bermuda Institute of Ocean Sciences
jobs.dateNote: Last year's deadline was 1 April
jobs.eligibility: Bermudians and PRC holders
jobs.summary: Ocean, climate and environmental research placements with a faculty mentor. Academic credit is possible through your university.

jobs.title: NSF Research Experiences for Undergraduates
jobs.company: ASU Bermuda Institute of Ocean Sciences
jobs.dateNote: Applications expected to open late January or early February 2027, subject to NSF funding renewal
jobs.eligibility: U.S. citizens or permanent residents aged 18+, enrolled as undergraduates before and after the programme
jobs.summary: Fully funded research internships mentored by BIOS scientists, with presentations, workshops and field trips.

jobs.title: Bermuda Internship
jobs.dateNote: Last year's deadline was 31 January
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian or PRC holders aged 18+ interested in law
jobs.summary: A paid internship at an offshore law firm, working on live client matters with lawyers at every level.

jobs.title: ILS Education Initiative Internships
jobs.company: ILS Bermuda (with Marsh, the BMA and Hiscox ILS)
jobs.dateNote: Last year's deadline was 9 January
jobs.eligibility: Students — see ILS Bermuda for each host's criteria
jobs.summary: Paid summer placements in insurance-linked securities with host firms that have included Marsh, the Bermuda Monetary Authority and Hiscox ILS.

jobs.title: ABIR Member Summer Internships
jobs.dateNote: Apply through member companies

jobs.summary: Around 100 paid placements each summer across member firms such as AIG, Arch, Chubb, Everest, Hiscox, PartnerRe and RenaissanceRe.

jobs.title: BILTIR Intern Programme
jobs.company: Bermuda International Long Term Insurers & Reinsurers
jobs.dateNote: Each member firm sets its own deadline — for summer 2026 they ran from late January to April. The 2027 list isn't posted yet

jobs.summary: BILTIR publishes a yearly list of summer placements at its member life insurers and reinsurers (for 2026: firms such as Hannover Re, Fortitude Re, Resolution Life, Sun Life and Catalina), mostly in actuarial, finance and policy roles. You apply to each firm directly.

jobs.title: HeadStart Summer Internship
jobs.dateNote: Dates not yet announced
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian students
jobs.summary: PwC's summer programme for Bermudian students, with on-the-job training and a possible path to a full-time role.

jobs.title: Summer Internship (Legal & Appleby Global Services)
jobs.dateNote: Dates not yet announced
jobs.eligibility: Students interested in law, or corporate and fiduciary services
jobs.summary: Legal interns rotate departments every two weeks with a lawyer mentor; AGS interns rotate through corporate admin, compliance and onboarding.

jobs.title: London Office Internship
jobs.dateNote: Last call opened February 2026
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian graduates
jobs.summary: Support Bermuda's diplomacy with the UK, the EU and international bodies from the Government's London office.

jobs.title: Curatorial Summer Internship
jobs.dateNote: Last cycle's deadline was in April
jobs.eligibility: Undergraduate or graduate students and recent graduates
jobs.summary: Collections management, conservation, research and exhibit work. Paid and unpaid places are offered.

jobs.title: Summer Internship Programme
jobs.dateNote: Dates not yet announced
jobs.eligibility: High school or university students and recent graduates based in Bermuda
jobs.summary: A short paid internship in advocacy and community campaigns. Last year paid $21.43 an hour for two places.

jobs.title: Newsroom & Marketing Summer Internship
jobs.dateNote: Enquire by email any time
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian students interested in journalism or media
jobs.summary: Reporting and social-media tracks with the island's daily newspaper. The article explains how to get in touch.

jobs.title: Hamilton Insurance Summer Internship (Bermuda)
jobs.dateNote: Accepting applications now on LinkedIn
jobs.eligibility: Undergraduates entering their junior year of university
jobs.summary: Hamilton's Bermuda summer programme places university students with the insurer and reinsurer for the summer. Applications for the next cohort are open.

jobs.title: Summer Student Programme
jobs.dateNote: Applications open on the last business day of December and close on the last business day of February each year
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian students aged 18+ with a Bermuda social insurance number; healthcare-related studies preferred
jobs.summary: Summer work for Bermudian college and university students at King Edward VII Memorial Hospital and Mid-Atlantic Wellness Institute, in clinical areas and support departments such as finance, IT and pharmacy.

jobs.title: Summer Employment Programme (college & university students)
jobs.company: Government of Bermuda — Department of Workforce Development
jobs.dateNote: 2026 registration closed 31 December 2025; the 2027 call has not been announced yet
jobs.eligibility: Bermudians enrolled in college or university (2026 cycle required a 2.7+ GPA)
jobs.summary: The Government places Bermudian college and university students with host employers for paid summer work experience; 102 students were placed in 2026.

jobs.title: Marine Mammal Training Internship
jobs.dateNote: Rolling sessions in 2027. Deadlines: 8 Jan (Mar–May session), 8 Mar (Jun–Aug), 14 Jun (Sep–Nov), 31 Aug (Nov session). Early applications preferred; places can fill before the deadline
jobs.eligibility: 18+, college students or recent graduates; must pass a swim test and commit to the full three months
jobs.summary: A full-time, unpaid three-month placement caring for and training dolphins and helping with guest education at Dockyard. Academic credit may be arranged through your school.

jobs.title: Intro-to-Insurance Summer Intern Programme
jobs.dateNote: BFIS lists applications as open until 26 March 2027; supporting documents are submitted after the start of the year and interviews run by Zoom in April
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian or PRC-holding undergraduates planning an insurance career
jobs.summary: A short, intensive introduction to the insurance industry for small groups of Bermudian undergraduates, hosted in Bermuda, London and Chicago. A stipend is paid, and overseas travel and lodging are covered.

jobs.title: John L. and Karen C. Pye Memorial Internship
jobs.dateNote: Applications open January 2027
jobs.eligibility: Canadian students of marine or environmental science, 18+, entering at least second year
jobs.summary: An annual six-week placement in research, conservation and education at the Bermuda Aquarium, Museum & Zoo for one Canadian student, with housing, a meal allowance and a bus pass provided.

jobs.title: Summer Internship (law students)
jobs.dateNote: No dates published; the firm invites Bermudian law students to contact HR about summer work
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian law students
jobs.summary: A summer introduction to legal practice at the Hamilton law firm. Enquiries go to the firm's HR operations manager, listed on its careers page.

jobs.title: Summer Internship Programme

jobs.eligibility: Students
jobs.summary: An annual programme run by Allshores (the group behind BF&M and Argus) that placed 18 interns in Bermuda in 2026, some returning for a second summer, across marketing, IT, finance, property and casualty, employee benefits and legal and compliance, alongside development sessions and networking events.

jobs.title: Summer Student Programme
jobs.dateNote: Recurring summer programme; 2027 dates and application process not yet announced
jobs.eligibility: University and college students (BELCO scholarship recipients have taken part)
jobs.summary: Summer placements at Bermuda's electric utility (17 students in 2026) across engineering, IT, human resources and operations, open to new and returning students from universities overseas and Bermuda College.

jobs.title: CG Insurance Summer Internship Programme
jobs.dateNote: The 2026 window ran from February to 30 April 2026; 2027 dates not yet announced
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian college students or recent graduates
jobs.summary: An in-person summer programme at CG's Reid Street office, rotating through property and casualty, medical, compliance, finance, marketing and legal, plus a group-wide project.

jobs.title: Summer Genetics Lab Internship
jobs.dateNote: Dates for 2027 not announced yet — the 2026 programme ran about eight weeks over the summer
jobs.eligibility: Students (criteria not published)
jobs.summary: Roughly two months inside Bermuda's own genomics lab: preparing and sequencing DNA, an introduction to pharmacogenetics, and conservation work tied to the Cahow recovery effort, all with mentoring from the lab team.

jobs.title: Summer Internship Programme
jobs.location: Hamilton (other placements in London and the US)
jobs.dateNote: Dates for 2027 not announced yet — the programme has run every summer since 2021
jobs.eligibility: Undergraduate students (criteria not published)
jobs.summary: Mosaic's yearly summer intake places students in teams such as underwriting, finance and marketing; in 2026 the Bermuda seat was in communications and marketing, with other interns in London, New York and Chicago.

jobs.title: Chubb Select Internship
jobs.dateNote: 2027 dates not published yet — past cohorts ran from early June to mid-August
jobs.eligibility: Bermudian university students interested in an insurance career
jobs.summary: Chubb's long-running Bermuda insurance internship, now past its tenth year. Interns rotate through different business units in their first summer, and some are invited back for a second summer in support functions.

jobs.title: 12-Month Education & Curatorial Internship
jobs.dateNote: The 2026 intake closed on 31 May 2026; the next intake has not been announced
jobs.eligibility: Recent university graduates (any subject) who are Bermudian, a spouse of a Bermudian, or hold PRC status
jobs.summary: A paid year-long placement at the museum for a new graduate, covering education programmes, curatorial work and community outreach. Separate from the museum's short summer internship.

jobs.title: Winter Legal Internship 2026 (Appleby Bermuda Ltd)
jobs.dateNote: Accepting applications now (posted 20 August 2026); the programme runs in December 2026 and no closing date is given, so apply soon

jobs.title: Winter Internship 2026 (Appleby Global Services)
jobs.dateNote: Accepting applications now (posted 21 August 2026); no closing date or exact programme dates are given
jobs.eligibility: Students who have finished at least one year of an undergraduate degree; comfortable with Word, Excel and Outlook, and corporate experience is a plus
jobs.summary: A winter placement with Appleby's fiduciary and corporate administration arm, helping keep company records and compliance files up to date, prepare regulatory filings, draft minutes and run AML/KYC checks. Apply online with a 250–500 word personal statement.

jobs.title: Summer Intern Programme (Bermuda)
jobs.dateNote: 2027 dates not announced yet. For 2026, Bermuda applications ran 1–28 February, with interviews in March–April and the programme from 29 June to 21 August
jobs.eligibility: Students and entry-level candidates looking for a first role; no formal criteria are published
jobs.summary: Convex places summer interns in one team for eight weeks, alongside development sessions and a group project. Applying takes a CV and a short written answer, followed by a virtual interview and then an in-person one with the team.

jobs.title: Youth Internship (social media & marketing)
jobs.dateNote: Bernews reports that recruitment for the 2027 programme opens in January 2027; no exact date yet
jobs.eligibility: High school students
jobs.summary: A six-week summer programme for high schoolers that mixes marketing workshops (three days a week) with two days a week creating content at a local host organisation, ending with a presentation to host mentors.
